reason: Base case is immediate. For the recurrence, fix j and append the value j to a length-k permutation after shifting every old value at least j up by 1; this preserves the first k-1 comparisons, and the final comparison is positive exactly when the old last value i satisfies i<j, and negative exactly when i>=j. This gives a bijection between the relevant stage-k classes and the stage-(k+1) class with last rank j. Summing the stage-n classes over the final rank gives f(s).
